sio2_quenching_3_subtask_structure_retri.name: SiO2 Structure Retrieval for Quenching - Level 3
sio2_quenching_3_subtask_structure_retri.description: Retrieve structure of SiO2 (or a molten restart) and convert it to LAMMPS data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

sio2_quenching_3_subtask_potential_file.name: SiO2 Potential File for Quenching - Level 3
sio2_quenching_3_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure the appropriate Tersoff potential file for SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

sio2_quenching_3_subtask_quenching.name: SiO2 NPT Quenching - Level 3
sio2_quenching_3_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible SiO2 molten structure and Tersoff potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the quenching process by cooling the system under NPT. As the final output, return the final density and the absolute path to the simulation log file.

sio2_quenching_3_subtask_tg_detection.name: Quartz Glass Transition Temperature Detection - Level 3
sio2_quenching_3_subtask_tg_detection.description: Given the path to the log file from the quenching simulation, analyze the density versus temperature data to detect the glass transition temperature (Tg). Report the Tg value in Kelvin.
